\documentclass[border=3pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning,spy}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  >=Stealth,
  spy using outlines={rectangle,magnification=3,width=3cm,height=1.5cm,connect spies},
  stage/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=1.3cm,minimum height=.65cm}
]
  \draw[help lines] (0,0) grid (4,3);
  \node[stage,fill=blue!15] (queued) at (1.3,1.5) {queued};
  \node[stage,fill=green!15] (running) at (3.1,1.5) {running};
  \draw[very thick,blue,-Stealth] (queued) -- node[above,font=\scriptsize] {dispatch} (running);
  \spy[orange] on (2.2,1.5) in node at (5.8,1.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
